CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  March 11, 2025

 The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – March 11, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai;
  Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Anki Udani, Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – February 25, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the February 25, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the February 25, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA

 AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB- 24-098
  • 1812 Westmont Drive
  • Applicant: Quang Tiet
  • Request: This is an application for a new 322 SF addition to the front,
  new roof design, and enclosure of an existing covered patio in the
  rear of an existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the fascia board color to match roof material or similar dark
  color.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the fascia board color to match roof material or similar dark
  color.
  2) Update the material board to show a decorative railing design
  appropriate to the architectural style.
  3) Update elevation keynotes and material board to show accurate
  stucco color name.
  4) Revise existing floor plan and elevations to show existing chimney
  and show whether it is planned to be demolished.
  5) Add labels in elevations to indicate where all the new windows are
  to be located.
  6) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-153
  • 1117 East Main Street
  • Applicant: Leo Lazalde
  • Request: This is an application for an exterior remodel and new roof
  equipment screening for an existing 1-story commercial building for a
  remote kitchen business.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  3
  03/11/2025
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise elevations to show the overall building height.
  2) Remove the color label/keynote from the existing shingles, if
  shingles are to remain existing.
  3) The applicant should screen Southeast wall facing East Main
  Street by landscaping.
  4) Update the proposed South Elevation show rooftop screening.
  5) Provide a horizontal rail at the top of the proposed fence to match
  sliding gate design.
  6) The applicant should either: propose transitional fencing on top of
  the existing block wall that creates a smooth transition in height
  from the proposed 6 ft. high fence to the height of the adjacent
  block wall; or lower the height of the proposed fence to 4 ft. to be
  more aligned with the height of the adjacent block wall.
  7) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-078
  • 29 North Vega Street
  • Applicant: Sarina Troung
  • Request: This is an application for a new 2,050 SF 1- and 2-story
  addition and remodel to an existing 1-story single-family residence
  with a new attached 4-car garage located in the rear.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1) The applicant should select a stone veneer material / product that
  renders an authentic, natural appearance with thicker stone
  pieces for logical structural support.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  4
  03/11/2025
   1) Revise the proposed door style to be more appropriate to the
  Colonial Revival style.
  2) Revise the exterior wall cladding to be a combination of smooth
  stucco and quoins at the building corners, where quoins are to be
  a natural stone of an appropriate scale.
  3) Update the color selection for stone an stucco to be
  complementary to each other.
  4) Reduce the overhang and length of corbels.
  5) Remove the upper transom windows above sliders to allow for
  taller slider windows.
  6) Provide standard grids / muntins on the proposed windows to be
  consistent with the Colonial Revival style.
  7) Revise the details and proportions of the front porch post caps.
  8) Revise the proposed exterior lighting style to be more appropriate
  to the Colonial Revival style.
  9) Show the exterior light fixtures at an appropriate height.
  10) Update the material board to show clear and accurate images of
  the proposed colors and materials.
  11) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings including
  colored elevations for City Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-148
  • 516 Alahmar Street North
  • Applicant: Brian Chen
  • Request: This is an application for a new 2-story single-family
  residence with an attached 2-car & one detached 1-car garage

MOTION:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
